name: std::float_denorm_style
intro: Enumeration constants of type std::float_denorm_style indicate support of subnormal values by floating-point types.

sections.title: Enumeration constants
sections.text:
Name

  Definition




  std::denorm_indeterminate

  Support of subnormal values cannot be determined




  std::denorm_absent

  The type does not support subnormal values




  std::denorm_present

  The type allows subnormal values

summary: Enumeration constants of type std::float_denorm_style indicate support of subnormal values by floating-point types.
